# EPIC-0006: Migrate APOD source to science.nasa.gov

Branch: `feat/epic-0006-apod-source-migration` (off `dev` at `461a978`). Merge path: feature -> `dev` -> `main`. Deploy from `main` only.

## Context

NASA moved APOD to science.nasa.gov. `api.nasa.gov/planetary/apod` now returns 200 with the NASA logo for every date, and the Worker cached and served it (production `/sd` = 8,928 B logo, `/optimized` and `/thumb` 502). Nothing validated upstream content, the image allowlist accepted any `.nasa.gov` host, and cache keys are date-only so the bad entries outlive a deploy.

Fix: switch permanently to `https://science.nasa.gov/wp-json/wp/v2/apod-basic/YYMMDD` (no key), validate at the boundary, derive image URLs from the `assets.science.nasa.gov` APOD asset tree, delete the dead apod.nasa.gov scrape, and version the cache keys. Six board tasks (TASK-0042..0047) define the work; this plan sequences them and settles the open design points.

Verified live today (2026-10-20):
- 261020 image day: `hdurl` = `https://assets.science.nasa.gov/dynamicimage/assets/science/cds/apod/apod/2026/october/AntiRainbow_Esposti_5120.jpg?w=5120&h=...`. Original at `.../content/dam/science/cds/apod/apod/2026/october/AntiRainbow_Esposti_5120.jpg` (200, image/jpeg, 1,100,460 B). `dynamicimage` with no query = 1280px rendition (200, no Content-Length). 2015 entries have `hdurl` already as `content/dam/...?w=...`.
- 261018 YouTube day: `media_type: "video"`, `hdurl` = poster under `cds/apod`, `basic_html` has `<iframe ... src="//www.youtube.com/embed/DzrCEm1ZBRY?rel=0">`.
- 261016 MP4 day: `hdurl: ""`, `basic_html` has `<video controls><source src="https://assets.science.nasa.gov/content/dam/science/cds/apod/apod/2026/october/CRS35-Holland30s1080p.mp4">`.
- Placeholder entries: `hdurl` under `/science/astro/programs/cosmic-origins/images/misc/news-thumbnail.png` (outside `/cds/apod/`).
- Unpublished date: 404 `{"code":"apod_basic_not_found"}`. wp-json `cache-control: max-age=60`. `explanation` starts `<strong>Explanation: </strong>`. `copyright` = `credit`, HTML. Only `&amp;` seen in text.
- Landing `index.html` reads only `title`, `date`, `width`, `height`, `error` from `/info`.

## Decisions

- **Normalize before caching.** Cache the internal `Apod` model (about 1 KB), not the raw record with 11 KB `basic_html`. Deviation from TASK-0042 §1 wording; amend that line.
- **Image day with no usable image = invalid upstream data.** Throws, goes through `handleUpstreamFailure` (stale or 502), never cached. Video day with no usable poster = valid, cached, walkback. This is what rejects the logo and placeholder shapes.
- **404 is "not published" only when body `code === "apod_basic_not_found"`.** Any other 404 is an upstream failure (stale tier stays useful if NASA removes the endpoint).
- **`/info` contract (user decided):** `url` = video URL on video days, else SD image; `hdurl` = HD image served at `/` (poster on video days); add `permalink`. `url` may be `null` on a video day when no embed is found.
- **No 429 passthrough, no `NasaApiError`.** All upstream failures are 502.
- **Zod 4** (`npm i zod@^4`, runtime dependency), strict only on `date`, `title`, `media_type`; everything else `.nullish()`.
- **Commit order: TASK-0044 first** (pure deletion against the old source, shrinks the 0042 diff), then 0042, 0043, 0045, 0046, 0047. The board's `blocked_by: [TASK-0042]` on 0044 is logical, not technical.
- One commit per task, single-line Conventional Commits, ask before each commit. No em dashes in any new copy, comments, or docs.
- Everything stays in `src/index.ts` (project convention; tests import `../src/index`).

}
const ApodBasic = z.object({

  permalink: z.string().nullish(), basic_html: z.string().nullish(),
});

## Context

NASA moved APOD to science.nasa.gov. `api.nasa.gov/planetary/apod` now returns 200 with the NASA logo for every date, and the Worker cached and served it (production `/sd` = 8,928 B logo, `/optimized` and `/thumb` 502). Nothing validated upstream content, the image allowlist accepted any `.nasa.gov` host, and cache keys are date-only so the bad entries outlive a deploy.

Fix: switch permanently to `https://science.nasa.gov/wp-json/wp/v2/apod-basic/YYMMDD` (no key), validate at the boundary, derive image URLs from the `assets.science.nasa.gov` APOD asset tree, delete the dead apod.nasa.gov scrape, and version the cache keys. Six board tasks (TASK-0042..0047) define the work; this plan sequences them and settles the open design points.

Verified live today (2026-10-20):
- 261020 image day: `hdurl` = `https://assets.science.nasa.gov/dynamicimage/assets/science/cds/apod/apod/2026/october/AntiRainbow_Esposti_5120.jpg?w=5120&h=...`. Original at `.../content/dam/science/cds/apod/apod/2026/october/AntiRainbow_Esposti_5120.jpg` (200, image/jpeg, 1,100,460 B). `dynamicimage` with no query = 1280px rendition (200, no Content-Length). 2015 entries have `hdurl` already as `content/dam/...?w=...`.
- 261018 YouTube day: `media_type: "video"`, `hdurl` = poster under `cds/apod`, `basic_html` has `<iframe ... src="//www.youtube.com/embed/DzrCEm1ZBRY?rel=0">`.
- 261016 MP4 day: `hdurl: ""`, `basic_html` has `<video controls><source src="https://assets.science.nasa.gov/content/dam/science/cds/apod/apod/2026/october/CRS35-Holland30s1080p.mp4">`.
- Placeholder entries: `hdurl` under `/science/astro/programs/cosmic-origins/images/misc/news-thumbnail.png` (outside `/cds/apod/`).
- Unpublished date: 404 `{"code":"apod_basic_not_found"}`. wp-json `cache-control: max-age=60`. `explanation` starts `<strong>Explanation: </strong>`. `copyright` = `credit`, HTML. Only `&amp;` seen in text.
- Landing `index.html` reads only `title`, `date`, `width`, `height`, `error` from `/info`.

## Decisions

- **Normalize before caching.** Cache the internal `Apod` model (about 1 KB), not the raw record with 11 KB `basic_html`. Deviation from TASK-0042 §1 wording; amend that line.
- **Image day with no usable image = invalid upstream data.** Throws, goes through `handleUpstreamFailure` (stale or 502), never cached. Video day with no usable poster = valid, cached, walkback. This is what rejects the logo and placeholder shapes.
- **404 is "not published" only when body `code === "apod_basic_not_found"`.** Any other 404 is an upstream failure (stale tier stays useful if NASA removes the endpoint).
- **`/info` contract (user decided):** `url` = video URL on video days, else SD image; `hdurl` = HD image served at `/` (poster on video days); add `permalink`. `url` may be `null` on a video day when no embed is found.
- **No 429 passthrough, no `NasaApiError`.** All upstream failures are 502.
- **Zod 4** (`npm i zod@^4`, runtime dependency), strict only on `date`, `title`, `media_type`; everything else `.nullish()`.
- **Commit order: TASK-0044 first** (pure deletion against the old source, shrinks the 0042 diff), then 0042, 0043, 0045, 0046, 0047. The board's `blocked_by: [TASK-0042]` on 0044 is logical, not technical.
- One commit per task, single-line Conventional Commits, ask before each commit. No em dashes in any new copy, comments, or docs.
- Everything stays in `src/index.ts` (project convention; tests import `../src/index`).

## Commit 2: TASK-0042 `feat(api): fetch APOD from science.nasa.gov apod-basic`

`package.json`: add `zod` (`^4`) under `dependencies`.

`src/index.ts`
```ts
const APOD_BASIC_URL = "https://science.nasa.gov/wp-json/wp/v2/apod-basic";
const APOD_BASIC_FIELDS = "date,title,media_type,explanation,copyright,hdurl,permalink,basic_html";
const USER_AGENT = "nasa-picture-proxy/1.0 (+https://nasapicture.com)";

interface ApodImage { sd: string; hd: string; hdFallback: string }
export interface Apod {
  date: string; title: string; explanation: string; copyright: string | null;
  media_type: "image" | "video"; permalink: string;
  image: ApodImage | null;   // APOD asset URLs, null only on video days without a usable poster
  video_url: string | null;
}
const ApodBasic = z.object({
  date: z.string(), title: z.string().trim().min(1), media_type: z.enum(["image", "video"]),
  explanation: z.string().nullish(), copyright: z.string().nullish(), hdurl: z.string().nullish(),
  permalink: z.string().nullish(), basic_html: z.string().nullish(),
});
export function apodAssetPath(url: string): string | null
export function normalizeApod(raw: unknown, date: string): Apod   // throws on invalid
async function fetchApodFromUpstream(log, devFlags, date, cacheReq, staleReq): Promise<Apod | null>
```
- `apodAssetPath(url)`: `new URL` in try/catch; require `https:` and host `assets.science.nasa.gov`; match `pathname` against `/^\/(?:dynamicimage\/assets|content\/dam)\/(science\/cds\/apod\/.+\.(?:jpe?g|png|gif|webp))$/i`; return the captured asset path or `null`. `pathname` is used verbatim so `%20` filenames survive.
- `normalizeApod(raw, date)`: `ApodBasic.safeParse`; throw on failure (log `z.prettifyError`) or when `date !== requested`. Build `image` from `hdurl` via `apodAssetPath`: `sd = https://assets.science.nasa.gov/dynamicimage/assets/${p}`, `hd = https://assets.science.nasa.gov/content/dam/${p}`, `hdFallback = hdurl`. (basic_html fallback and `video_url` land in commit 3; in this commit `video_url: null`.) `explanation`: `stripHtml` then strip `^Explanation:\s*`. `copyright` and `title`: `stripHtml` (`null` when empty). If `media_type === "image" && !image` throw. The date-to-`YYMMDD` conversion is `date.slice(2).replaceAll("-", "")`.
- `fetchApodFromUpstream`: `fetch(`${APOD_BASIC_URL}/${yymmdd}?_fields=${APOD_BASIC_FIELDS}`, { headers: { "User-Agent": USER_AGENT } })`. 404 with body `code === "apod_basic_not_found"` -> log, return `null` (nothing cached). Other non-ok -> log `body.slice(0, 200)`, `handleUpstreamFailure`. ok -> `normalizeApod` in try/catch; on throw -> `handleUpstreamFailure(..., reason)`. Valid -> `writeApodCaches`, return.
- `handleUpstreamFailure(log, cache, staleReq, cacheKey, reason: string): Promise<Apod>`: stale or `throw new Error(`APOD source failed: ${reason}`)`.
- `fetchApod(log, devFlags, date: string): Promise<Apod | null>`; `date` required (drop `?? todayET()`); `inflightApod: Map<string, Promise<Apod | null>>`.
- `findLatestResolvable(log, devFlags)`: `const apod = await fetchApod(...); const resolved = apod && resolveApod(apod);` rest unchanged.
- `ResolvedApod` becomes `{ apod: Apod; image: ApodImage; source: ImageSource }`. `resolveApod(apod)`: `apod.image ? { apod, image: apod.image, source: apod.media_type === "video" ? "video_thumbnail" : "image" } : null`.
- Delete `ApodResponse`, `NasaApiError`, `NASA_APOD_URL`, `fetchApodFromNasa`, `Env.NASA_API_KEY`, the `DEMO_KEY` line, every `apiKey` parameter, both 429 branches (status always 502).
- Dev fixtures: two `Apod` literals. `?dev=video`: `media_type: "video"`, `image` = the 261018 poster (`sd`/`hd`/`hdFallback` built from `science/cds/apod/apod/2026/october/SonifiedEagleNebulaPillars.jpg`), `video_url: "https://www.youtube.com/embed/DzrCEm1ZBRY"`. `?dev=video-no-thumb`: `image: null`, `video_url` = the 261016 MP4 URL. These pass both the old and new allowlist.
- Routes: `resolved.image.sd` / `resolved.image.hd` replace `imageUrl` / `imageHdUrl`. `/info` adds `permalink`, `url: apod.media_type === "video" ? apod.video_url : apod.image.sd`, `hdurl: resolved.image.hd`.
- Header comment line 5 and the `/about` text are left for commit 5.

## Commit 3: TASK-0043 `feat(api): resolve HD, SD, and video URLs from apod-basic`

`src/index.ts`
- `normalizeApod`: when `hdurl` yields no asset path, scan `basic_html` for the first `href="..."` / `src="..."` value (decode `&amp;`) that passes `apodAssetPath`; use it for `image`. `video_url`: `<iframe[^>]+src="([^"]+)"` (prefix `https:` when it starts with `//`) else `<source[^>]+src="([^"]+)"`; else `null`.

- `fetchImageDimensions(log, resolved.image.hd)` unchanged; a 404 there already degrades to `null` width/height.

## Commit 4: TASK-0045 `feat(api): version cache keys`

`src/index.ts`
```ts
// Bump whenever the cached shape or the upstream source changes. Old keys are
// never read again and expire on their own; no purge needed.
const CACHE_VERSION = "v2";
function cacheUrl(kind: "apod" | "image" | "dimensions", key: string): string {
  return `https://api.nasapicture.com/_cache/${CACHE_VERSION}/${kind}/${key}`;
}
```

Recent incidents (video APOD tripping walkback, unexplained NASA API 500 on 2026-04-08) have repeatedly hurt the core promise — showing today's image reliably. TASK-0020 shipped alongside EPIC-0004's TASK-0019; TASK-0021 (cron warming) is the remaining P1.

## Tasks

### ~~TASK-0020: HTML scraping fallback for NASA API outages~~ [done]

Shipped with TASK-0019. `scrapeApodForDate` + `parseApodHtml` in `src/index.ts` kick in from `handleUpstreamFailure` whenever the API errors and stale cache is empty. Handles UTF-8 and UTF-16 LE/BE APOD pages (NASA silently serves some pages as UTF-16 LE with BOM despite a UTF-8 Content-Type header). **Directly addresses the 2026-04-08 outage.**

### TASK-0021: Automated daily cache warming via Cron Trigger [P1]

Add a `scheduled()` handler with a cron trigger to warm the edge cache after APOD rollover. Calls `findLatestImage`, `fetchImageCached`, and `fetchImageDimensions` to populate metadata and image bytes proactively. **Combined with TASK-0020, guarantees a fresh entry in stale cache so outages never exhaust our fallback.**
---
## Sequence

1. ~~TASK-0020~~ — done
2. **TASK-0021** [P1] — Cron cache warming. Now that scrape is in place, cron warming guarantees stale cache never runs dry.
3. TASK-0011 — R2 storage layer. Larger effort, unblocks follow-on features (gallery, timezone Phase 2).
4. TASK-0032 — GitHub Action. Small, can be done anytime.

The per-edit hook surfaces only the immediate tier: mechanical, unambiguous problems worth interrupting an edit for, such as broken images, overflowing content, contrast and legibility failures, gradient text, glow shadows, and design-system drift. Everything else (copy cadence, palette and typography taste, layout rhythm) is deferred to a deep pass on the `Stop` hook event, which runs the full rule set over every UI file touched in the session and surfaces the remaining findings once, deduplicated against what the per-edit pass already reported. A session with nothing left to report stops silently. Set `hook.perEditRules` to `"all"` in `.impeccable/config.json` to restore the full rule set on every edit. The Stop deep pass is wired for Claude Code, Codex, and Grok Build, which dispatch a native `Stop` hook event. Cursor does not get one (its stop hook is not consistently dispatched; the pre-write gate covers it), and GitHub Copilot's stop-style events do not feed context back to the model, so they keep the full detector per edit. Grok also fires an observe-only Stop with `reason: "shutdown"` after `end_turn`; skip that one, scan only `end_turn`.

211	  log: string[],
212	  cache: Cache,

216	): Promise<ApodResponse> {

223	    return stale.json() as Promise<ApodResponse>;

254	    return handleUpstreamFailure(log, cache, staleReq, cacheKey, res.status);

/**
 * APOD Proxy — Cloudflare Worker
 *
 * Serves NASA's Astronomy Picture of the Day from a stable URL.
 * Uses Cloudflare's edge cache for both the API response and the
 * image bytes — no KV, no cron, no external storage.
 *
 * Routes:
 *   GET /          → today's APOD image (high res, falls back to standard)
 *   GET /sd        → today's APOD image (standard res)
 *   GET /optimized → optimized image (≤1200px, auto WebP/AVIF)
 *   GET /thumb     → tiny thumbnail (32px, blurred WebP)
 *   GET /info      → JSON metadata (includes image dimensions)
 *   GET /about     → plain-text description and attribution
 */

import { z } from "zod";

export interface Env {
  ENVIRONMENT?: string;
}

// NASA's APOD feed. A WordPress REST endpoint on science.nasa.gov, keyed by
// YYMMDD, no API key. See EPIC-0006 for the verified field behavior.
const APOD_BASIC_URL = "https://science.nasa.gov/wp-json/wp/v2/apod-basic";
const APOD_BASIC_FIELDS = "date,title,media_type,explanation,copyright,hdurl,permalink,basic_html";
const APOD_ASSET_HOST = "https://assets.science.nasa.gov";
const USER_AGENT = "nasa-picture-proxy/1.0 (+https://nasapicture.com)";
const MAX_LOOKBACK_DAYS = 7;
const CACHE_TTL = 21600;      // 6 hours — APOD changes once/day
const STALE_CACHE_TTL = 86400; // 24 hours — fallback when the APOD source is down

// Hosts allowed for image fetches. NASA hosts the photography itself; YouTube
// and Vimeo host video thumbnails linked from video APOD entries.
const ALLOWED_IMAGE_HOSTS = [
  ".nasa.gov",
  ".ytimg.com",
  ".youtube.com",
  ".vimeocdn.com",
];

// Upstream record, trimmed by `_fields`. Only what the proxy cannot work
// without is required; everything else degrades to empty.
const ApodBasic = z.object({
  date: z.string(),
  title: z.string().trim().min(1),
  media_type: z.enum(["image", "video"]),
  explanation: z.string().nullish(),
  copyright: z.string().nullish(),
  hdurl: z.string().nullish(),
  permalink: z.string().nullish(),
  basic_html: z.string().nullish(),
});

export interface ApodImage {
  sd: string;         // 1280px rendition (dynamicimage path, no params)
  hd: string;         // original bytes (content/dam path)
  hdFallback: string; // hdurl as NASA sent it, in case the original is missing
}

// Normalized, plain-text model. This is what gets cached.
export interface Apod {
  date: string;
  title: string;
  explanation: string;
  copyright: string | null;
  media_type: "image" | "video";
  permalink: string;
  image: ApodImage | null; // null only on video days without a usable poster
  video_url: string | null;
}

export type ImageSource = "image" | "video_thumbnail";

export interface ResolvedApod {
  apod: Apod;
  image: ApodImage;
  source: ImageSource;
}

export interface DevFlags {
  enabled: boolean;
  mode: string | null;
  tools: Set<string>;
}

const inflightApod = new Map<string, Promise<Apod | null>>();

/** Test-only: clear the in-flight promise map between test cases. */
export function __resetInflightApod(): void {
  inflightApod.clear();
}

// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Dev flag fixtures — only reachable when env.ENVIRONMENT === "development".
// Registered in REFE-0001. When a new mode is added here, update that table.
// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const DEV_POSTER_PATH = "science/cds/apod/apod/2026/october/SonifiedEagleNebulaPillars.jpg";

const VIDEO_FIXTURE: Apod = {
  date: "2026-10-18",
  title: "Fixture: Video APOD (dev=video)",
  explanation:
    "Dev fixture used to exercise the video-poster branch locally. " +
    "Shape mirrors a normalized apod-basic video entry. " +
    "See TASK-0019, TASK-0042 and REFE-0001 for context.",
  copyright: null,
  media_type: "video",
  permalink: "https://science.nasa.gov/image-article/apod-2026-october-18-sonified-eagle-nebula-pillars/",
  image: {
    sd: `${APOD_ASSET_HOST}/dynamicimage/assets/${DEV_POSTER_PATH}`,
    hd: `${APOD_ASSET_HOST}/content/dam/${DEV_POSTER_PATH}`,
    hdFallback: `${APOD_ASSET_HOST}/dynamicimage/assets/${DEV_POSTER_PATH}?w=3048&h=1708`,
  },
  video_url: "https://www.youtube.com/embed/DzrCEm1ZBRY",
};

const VIDEO_FIXTURE_NO_POSTER: Apod = {
  ...VIDEO_FIXTURE,
  title: "Fixture: Video APOD no poster (dev=video-no-thumb)",
  image: null,
  video_url: `${APOD_ASSET_HOST}/content/dam/science/cds/apod/apod/2026/october/CRS35-Holland30s1080p.mp4`,
};

export function devApodFixture(mode: string, date: string): Apod | null {
  if (mode === "video") return { ...VIDEO_FIXTURE, date };
  if (mode === "video-no-thumb") return { ...VIDEO_FIXTURE_NO_POSTER, date };
  return null;
}

export function parseDevFlags(url: URL, env: Env): DevFlags {
  const enabled = env.ENVIRONMENT === "development";
  if (!enabled) {
    return { enabled: false, mode: null, tools: new Set() };
  }
  const rawMode = url.searchParams.get("dev");
  const mode = rawMode && rawMode !== "off" && rawMode !== "" ? rawMode : null;
  const toolsCsv = url.searchParams.get("tools");
  const tools = new Set(
    toolsCsv
      ? toolsCsv.split(",").map((s) => s.trim()).filter(Boolean)
      : [],
  );
  return { enabled, mode, tools };
}

// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Upstream normalization
// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

// APOD photography lives under one asset tree. Anything else on the host
// (site chrome, the generic news thumbnail, videos) is not an APOD image.
const APOD_ASSET_PATH =
  /^\/(?:dynamicimage\/assets|content\/dam)\/(science\/cds\/apod\/.+\.(?:jpe?g|png|gif|webp))$/i;

/** Asset path under assets.science.nasa.gov, or null when the URL points anywhere else. */
export function apodAssetPath(url: string): string | null {
  let parsed: URL;
  try {
    parsed = new URL(url);
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
  if (parsed.protocol !== "https:" || parsed.hostname !== "assets.science.nasa.gov") return null;
  return parsed.pathname.match(APOD_ASSET_PATH)?.[1] ?? null;
}

function apodImage(url: string): ApodImage | null {
  const path = apodAssetPath(url);
  if (!path) return null;
  return {
    sd: `${APOD_ASSET_HOST}/dynamicimage/assets/${path}`,
    hd: `${APOD_ASSET_HOST}/content/dam/${path}`,
    hdFallback: url,
  };
}

function stripHtml(s: string): string {
  return s
    .replace(/<br\s*\/?>|<\/p>/gi, " ")
    .replace(/<[^>]+>/g, "")
    .replace(/&nbsp;/gi, " ")
    .replace(/&amp;/gi, "&")
    .replace(/&quot;/gi, '"')
    .replace(/&#39;/gi, "'")
    .replace(/&lt;/gi, "<")
    .replace(/&gt;/gi, ">")
    .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
    .trim();
}

/**
 * Validate an apod-basic record and map it to the internal model. Throws on
 * anything that must never be cached or served: schema failures, a record
 * for a different date, or an image day with no APOD image (the 2026-10-20
 * logo outage looked exactly like that).
 */
export function normalizeApod(raw: unknown, date: string): Apod {
  const parsed = ApodBasic.safeParse(raw);
  if (!parsed.success) {
    throw new Error(`invalid record: ${z.prettifyError(parsed.error)}`);
  }
  const rec = parsed.data;
  if (rec.date !== date) {
    throw new Error(`date mismatch: asked ${date}, got ${rec.date}`);
  }

  const image = apodImage(rec.hdurl ?? "");
  if (rec.media_type === "image" && !image) {
    throw new Error(`no APOD image in hdurl (${rec.hdurl})`);
  }

  const copyright = stripHtml(rec.copyright ?? "");
  return {
    date: rec.date,
    title: stripHtml(rec.title),
    explanation: stripHtml(rec.explanation ?? "").replace(/^Explanation:\s*/, ""),
    copyright: copyright || null,
    media_type: rec.media_type,
    permalink: rec.permalink ?? "",
    image,
    video_url: null,
  };
}

export function resolveApod(apod: Apod): ResolvedApod | null {
  if (!apod.image) return null;
  return {
    apod,
    image: apod.image,
    source: apod.media_type === "video" ? "video_thumbnail" : "image",
  };
}

// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Fetch and cache
// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function apodCacheUrl(key: string): string {
  return `https://api.nasapicture.com/_cache/apod/${key}`;
}

function todayET(): string {
  return new Date().toLocaleDateString("en-CA", { timeZone: "America/New_York" });
}

async function writeApodCaches(
  cache: Cache, cacheReq: Request, staleReq: Request, apod: Apod,
): Promise<void> {
  const body = JSON.stringify(apod);
  const cacheHeaders = { "Content-Type": "application/json", "Cache-Control": `public, max-age=${CACHE_TTL}` };
  const staleHeaders = { "Content-Type": "application/json", "Cache-Control": `public, max-age=${STALE_CACHE_TTL}` };
  await Promise.all([
    cache.put(cacheReq, new Response(body, { headers: cacheHeaders })),
    cache.put(staleReq, new Response(body, { headers: staleHeaders })),
  ]);
}

/** Cached APOD for a date, or null when NASA has not published it yet. */
async function fetchApod(log: string[], devFlags: DevFlags, date: string): Promise<Apod | null> {
  // Dev fixture short-circuit: only for today's date, bypasses cache entirely
  // so fixture runs never pollute real cached data.
  if (devFlags.enabled && devFlags.mode && date === todayET()) {
    const fixture = devApodFixture(devFlags.mode, date);
    if (fixture) {
      log.push(`  [fetchApod] ${date} → dev fixture (${devFlags.mode})`);
      return fixture;
    }
  }

  const cache = caches.default;
  const cacheReq = new Request(apodCacheUrl(date));
  const staleReq = new Request(apodCacheUrl(`${date}:stale`));

  // nasa-error bypasses the primary cache so every request exercises the
  // stale fallback path rather than hitting warm data.
  const bypassCache = devFlags.enabled && devFlags.mode === "nasa-error";

  if (!bypassCache) {
    const cached = await cache.match(cacheReq);
    if (cached) {
      log.push(`  [fetchApod] ${date} → cache HIT`);
      return cached.json() as Promise<Apod>;
    }
  }

  // Deduplicate concurrent requests for the same date
  const inflight = inflightApod.get(date);
  if (inflight) {
    log.push(`  [fetchApod] ${date} → coalesced with in-flight request`);
    return inflight;
  }

  const promise = fetchApodFromUpstream(log, devFlags, date, cacheReq, staleReq);
  inflightApod.set(date, promise);
  try {
    return await promise;
  } finally {
    inflightApod.delete(date);
  }
}

async function handleUpstreamFailure(
  log: string[], cache: Cache, staleReq: Request, date: string, reason: string,
): Promise<Apod> {
  // Stale cache is the only fallback. The HTML scrape that used to follow it
  // was removed in EPIC-0006: NASA's old APOD site redirects every page to
  // the science.nasa.gov index now.
  const stale = await cache.match(staleReq);
  if (stale) {
    log.push(`  [fetchApod] ${date} → stale cache fallback (${reason})`);
    return stale.json() as Promise<Apod>;
  }

  throw new Error(`APOD source failed: ${reason}`);
}

async function fetchApodFromUpstream(
  log: string[], devFlags: DevFlags, date: string, cacheReq: Request, staleReq: Request,
): Promise<Apod | null> {
  const cache = caches.default;

  if (devFlags.enabled && devFlags.mode === "nasa-error") {
    log.push(`  [fetchApod] ${date} → dev simulated nasa-error (skipping upstream)`);
    return handleUpstreamFailure(log, cache, staleReq, date, "simulated by ?dev=nasa-error");
  }

  // apod-basic keys entries by YYMMDD, like the old apYYMMDD.html pages did.
  const yymmdd = date.slice(2).replaceAll("-", "");
  const res = await fetch(`${APOD_BASIC_URL}/${yymmdd}?_fields=${APOD_BASIC_FIELDS}`, {
    headers: { "User-Agent": USER_AGENT },
  });
  log.push(`  [fetchApod] ${date} → ${res.status}`);

  if (res.status === 404) {
    const body = await res.json().catch(() => null) as { code?: string } | null;
    if (body?.code === "apod_basic_not_found") {
      // Not published yet (NASA posts at 00:05 ET). Not an outage, and
      // nothing to cache: the walkback serves the previous day.
      log.push(`  [fetchApod] ${date} → not published`);
      return null;
    }
    return handleUpstreamFailure(log, cache, staleReq, date, `404 ${JSON.stringify(body)}`);
  }

  if (!res.ok) {
    const body = (await res.text()).slice(0, 200);
    log.push(`  [fetchApod] body=${body}`);
    return handleUpstreamFailure(log, cache, staleReq, date, `status ${res.status}`);
  }

  let apod: Apod;
  try {
    apod = normalizeApod(await res.json(), date);
  } catch (err) {
    const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : "unknown";
    return handleUpstreamFailure(log, cache, staleReq, date, msg);
  }

  await writeApodCaches(cache, cacheReq, staleReq, apod);
  return apod;
}

async function findLatestResolvable(log: string[], devFlags: DevFlags): Promise<ResolvedApod> {
  let unresolvable = 0;
  let errors = 0;

  for (let i = 0; i <= MAX_LOOKBACK_DAYS; i++) {
    const d = new Date();
    d.setDate(d.getDate() - i);
    const date = d.toLocaleDateString("en-CA", { timeZone: "America/New_York" });

    try {
      const apod = await fetchApod(log, devFlags, date);
      const resolved = apod && resolveApod(apod);
      if (resolved) {
        if (i > 0 || resolved.source !== "image") {
          log.push(`  [findLatest] ${date} → ${resolved.source} (lookback=${i})`);
        }
        return resolved;
      }
      unresolvable++;
    } catch (err) {
      errors++;
      const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : "unknown";
      log.push(`  [findLatest] ${date} → error, skipping (${msg})`);
    }
  }

  throw new Error(
    `No image found in last ${MAX_LOOKBACK_DAYS + 1} days (${unresolvable} unresolvable, ${errors} errors)`,
  );
}

function validateImageUrl(url: string): void {
  const parsed = new URL(url);
  if (parsed.protocol !== "https:") {
    throw new Error(`Blocked image fetch: non-HTTPS scheme (${parsed.protocol})`);
  }
  if (!ALLOWED_IMAGE_HOSTS.some((suffix) => parsed.hostname.endsWith(suffix))) {
    throw new Error(`Blocked image fetch: unexpected host (${parsed.hostname})`);
  }
}

async function fetchImageCached(log: string[], url: string): Promise<Response> {
  validateImageUrl(url);

  const cache = caches.default;
  const cacheReq = new Request(`https://api.nasapicture.com/_cache/image/${encodeURIComponent(url)}`);
  const staleReq = new Request(`https://api.nasapicture.com/_cache/image/${encodeURIComponent(url)}:stale`);

  const cached = await cache.match(cacheReq);
  if (cached) {
    log.push(`  [fetchImage] ${url.slice(0, 80)}… → cache HIT`);
    return cached;
  }

  const res = await fetch(url);

  log.push(`  [fetchImage] ${url.slice(0, 80)}… → ${res.status}`);

  if (!res.ok) {
    // Try stale cache before giving up
    const stale = await cache.match(staleReq);
    if (stale) {
      log.push(`  [fetchImage] ${url.slice(0, 80)}… → stale cache fallback`);
      return stale;
    }
    throw new Error(`Image fetch failed: ${res.status}`);
  }

  const contentType = res.headers.get("Content-Type") || "image/jpeg";
  const contentLength = res.headers.get("Content-Length");
  const cacheHeaders: Record<string, string> = {
    "Content-Type": contentType,
    "Cache-Control": `public, max-age=${CACHE_TTL}`,
  };
  if (contentLength) cacheHeaders["Content-Length"] = contentLength;

  const staleCacheHeaders = { ...cacheHeaders, "Cache-Control": `public, max-age=${STALE_CACHE_TTL}` };

  const arrayBuffer = await res.arrayBuffer();
  await Promise.all([
    cache.put(cacheReq, new Response(arrayBuffer, { headers: cacheHeaders })),
    cache.put(staleReq, new Response(arrayBuffer, { headers: staleCacheHeaders })),
  ]);
  return new Response(arrayBuffer, { headers: cacheHeaders });
}

interface ImageDimensions {
  width: number;
  height: number;
}

async function fetchImageDimensions(log: string[], imageUrl: string): Promise<ImageDimensions | null> {
  validateImageUrl(imageUrl);

  const cache = caches.default;
  const cacheKey = `https://api.nasapicture.com/_cache/dimensions/${encodeURIComponent(imageUrl)}`;
  const cacheReq = new Request(cacheKey);
  const staleReq = new Request(`${cacheKey}:stale`);

  const cached = await cache.match(cacheReq);
  if (cached) {
    log.push(`  [dimensions] ${imageUrl.slice(0, 80)}… → cache HIT`);
    return cached.json() as Promise<ImageDimensions>;
  }

  try {
    const res = await fetch(imageUrl, {
      cf: { image: { format: "json" } },
    });

    if (!res.ok) {
      const stale = await cache.match(staleReq);
      if (stale) {
        log.push(`  [dimensions] ${imageUrl.slice(0, 80)}… → stale cache fallback`);
        return stale.json() as Promise<ImageDimensions>;
      }
      log.push(`  [dimensions] ${imageUrl.slice(0, 80)}… → ${res.status} (failed)`);
      return null;
    }

    const info = await res.json() as { original: { width: number; height: number } };
    const dimensions: ImageDimensions = {
      width: info.original.width,
      height: info.original.height,
    };

    log.push(`  [dimensions] ${imageUrl.slice(0, 80)}… → ${dimensions.width}×${dimensions.height}`);

    const body = JSON.stringify(dimensions);
    await Promise.all([
      cache.put(cacheReq, new Response(body, {
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "Cache-Control": `public, max-age=${CACHE_TTL}` },
      })),
      cache.put(staleReq, new Response(body, {
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "Cache-Control": `public, max-age=${STALE_CACHE_TTL}` },
      })),
    ]);
    return dimensions;
  } catch (err) {
    log.push(`  [dimensions] ${imageUrl.slice(0, 80)}… → error: ${err instanceof Error ? err.message : "unknown"}`);
    const stale = await cache.match(staleReq);
    if (stale) return stale.json() as Promise<ImageDimensions>;
    return null;
  }
}

function baseHeaders(origin: string, headers: Record<string, string> = {}): Record<string, string> {
  return {
    "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
    "Cache-Control": `public, max-age=${CACHE_TTL}`,
    "X-Content-Type-Options": "nosniff",
    "Link": [
      `<${origin}/>; rel="alternate"; type="image/*"; title="HD image"`,
      `<${origin}/sd>; rel="alternate"; type="image/*"; title="SD image"`,
      `<${origin}/optimized>; rel="alternate"; type="image/*"; title="Optimized image"`,
      `<${origin}/thumb>; rel="alternate"; type="image/webp"; title="Thumbnail"`,
      `<${origin}/info>; rel="describedby"`,
      `<${origin}/about>; rel="about"`,
    ].join(", "),
    ...headers,
  };
}

export default {
  async fetch(request: Request, env: Env): Promise<Response> {
    if (request.method === "OPTIONS") {
      return new Response(null, {
        headers: {
          "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
          "Access-Control-Allow-Methods": "GET, HEAD, OPTIONS",
          "Access-Control-Max-Age": "86400",
        },
      });
    }

    if (request.method !== "GET" && request.method !== "HEAD") {
      return new Response(
        JSON.stringify({ error: "Method not allowed. This API only supports GET requests." }),
        { status: 405, headers: { "Allow": "GET, HEAD, OPTIONS", "Content-Type": "application/json" } },
      );
    }

    const reqUrl = new URL(request.url);
    const { pathname } = reqUrl;
    const origin = reqUrl.origin;
    const start = Date.now();

    const log: string[] = [];
    let res: Response;

    try {
      const devFlags = parseDevFlags(reqUrl, env);
      if (devFlags.enabled && (devFlags.mode || devFlags.tools.size)) {
        log.push(
          `  [devFlags] mode=${devFlags.mode ?? "-"} tools=${
            devFlags.tools.size ? Array.from(devFlags.tools).join(",") : "-"
          }`,
        );
      }

      const sdPaths = ["/sd", "/image-sd.jpg"];
      const hdPaths = ["/", "/image.jpg"];
      const optimizedPaths = ["/optimized", "/image-optimized.jpg"];
      const thumbPaths = ["/thumb", "/thumb.jpg"];

      if (hdPaths.includes(pathname) || sdPaths.includes(pathname)) {
        const resolved = await findLatestResolvable(log, devFlags);
        const imageUrl = sdPaths.includes(pathname)
          ? resolved.image.sd
          : resolved.image.hd;

        const upstream = await fetchImageCached(log, imageUrl);
        const contentType = upstream.headers.get("Content-Type") || "image/jpeg";

        res = new Response(upstream.body, {
          headers: baseHeaders(origin, { "Content-Type": contentType }),
        });
      } else if (optimizedPaths.includes(pathname)) {
        const resolved = await findLatestResolvable(log, devFlags);
        const imageUrl = resolved.image.hd;
        validateImageUrl(imageUrl);

        const imageOpts: RequestInitCfPropertiesImage = {
          fit: "scale-down",
          width: 1200,
          quality: 85,
        };

        const accept = request.headers.get("Accept") || "";
        if (/image\/avif/.test(accept)) {
          imageOpts.format = "avif";
        } else if (/image\/webp/.test(accept)) {
          imageOpts.format = "webp";
        }

        log.push(`  [optimized] ${imageUrl.slice(0, 80)}… → cf.image ${JSON.stringify(imageOpts)}`);

        const upstream = await fetch(imageUrl, {
          cf: { image: imageOpts },
        });

        if (!upstream.ok) {
          throw new Error(`Image transform failed: ${upstream.status}`);
        }

        const contentType = upstream.headers.get("Content-Type") || "image/jpeg";

        res = new Response(upstream.body, {
          headers: baseHeaders(origin, { "Content-Type": contentType }),
        });
      } else if (thumbPaths.includes(pathname)) {
        const resolved = await findLatestResolvable(log, devFlags);
        const imageUrl = resolved.image.hd;
        validateImageUrl(imageUrl);

        const imageOpts: RequestInitCfPropertiesImage = {
          fit: "scale-down",
          width: 32,
          quality: 30,
          format: "webp",
          blur: 5,
        };

        log.push(`  [thumb] ${imageUrl.slice(0, 80)}… → cf.image ${JSON.stringify(imageOpts)}`);

        const upstream = await fetch(imageUrl, {
          cf: { image: imageOpts },
        });

        if (!upstream.ok) {
          throw new Error(`Thumbnail transform failed: ${upstream.status}`);
        }

        const contentType = upstream.headers.get("Content-Type") || "image/webp";

        res = new Response(upstream.body, {
          headers: baseHeaders(origin, { "Content-Type": contentType }),
        });
      } else if (pathname === "/info") {
        const endpoints = {
          "/": "Today's APOD image (high resolution, falls back to standard)",
          "/image.jpg": "Same as / with file extension (for contexts that need one)",
          "/sd": "Today's APOD image (standard resolution)",
          "/image-sd.jpg": "Same as /sd with file extension",
          "/optimized": "Optimized image (≤1200px, auto WebP/AVIF)",
          "/image-optimized.jpg": "Same as /optimized with file extension",
          "/thumb": "Tiny blurred thumbnail (32px WebP, ~1KB)",
          "/thumb.jpg": "Same as /thumb with file extension",
          "/info": "JSON metadata for today's APOD (includes image dimensions)",
          "/about": "Plain-text description and attribution",
        };

        try {
          const { apod, source, image } = await findLatestResolvable(log, devFlags);
          const dimensions = await fetchImageDimensions(log, image.hd);

          res = new Response(
            JSON.stringify({
              title: apod.title,
              date: apod.date,
              explanation: apod.explanation,
              media_type: apod.media_type,
              url: apod.media_type === "video" ? apod.video_url : image.sd,
              hdurl: image.hd,
              permalink: apod.permalink,
              copyright: apod.copyright,
              width: dimensions?.width ?? null,
              height: dimensions?.height ?? null,
              image_source: source,
              endpoints,
            }, null, 2),
            { headers: baseHeaders(origin, { "Content-Type": "application/json" }) },
          );
        } catch (err) {
          const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Unknown error";
          res = new Response(
            JSON.stringify({ error: message, endpoints }, null, 2),
            { status: 502, headers: baseHeaders(origin, { "Content-Type": "application/json" }) },
          );
        }
      } else if (pathname === "/about") {
        const text = [
          "",
          "     .        *          .          *          .        *",
          "   .         *                        .          .",
          "                 _   _    _    ____    _",
          "     *          | \\ | |  / \\  / ___|  / \\         .",
          "        .       |  \\| | / _ \\ \\___ \\ / _ \\",
          "           .    | |\\  |/ ___ \\ ___) / ___ \\   *",
          "     .          |_| \\_/_/   \\_\\____/_/   \\_\\        .",
          "  *                              .                *",
          "        .    *        .    *          .        .",
          "",
          "                   ── APOD Proxy ──",
          "",
          "  Proxy for NASA's Astronomy Picture of the Day.",
          "  Returns today's image at a static URL, no API key required.",
          "  Video days are skipped automatically.",
          "  Useful for wallpapers, <img> sources, and other zero-JS environments.",
          "",
          "  Usage:",
          `    <img src="${origin}/">`,
          "",
          "  Routes:",
          "    /                    HD image (default)",
          "    /image.jpg           HD image (with extension)",
          "    /sd                  Standard resolution",
          "    /image-sd.jpg        Standard resolution (with extension)",
          "    /optimized           Optimized (≤1200px, auto WebP/AVIF)",
          "    /image-optimized.jpg Optimized (with extension)",
          "    /thumb               Tiny blurred thumbnail (32px WebP)",
          "    /thumb.jpg           Thumbnail (with extension)",
          "    /info                JSON metadata (with dimensions)",
          "    /about               This page",
          "",
          "  Homepage: https://nasapicture.com",
          "",
          "  Built by Grant Keller | https://grantkeller.dev",
          "",
        ].join("\n");

        res = new Response(text, {
          headers: baseHeaders(origin, { "Content-Type": "text/plain; charset=utf-8" }),
        });
      } else {
        res = new Response(
          JSON.stringify({ error: "Not found. Routes: /, /sd, /optimized, /thumb, /info, /about" }),
          { status: 404, headers: baseHeaders(origin, { "Content-Type": "application/json" }) },
        );
      }
    } catch (err) {
      const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Unknown error";
      res = new Response(
        JSON.stringify({ error: message }),
        { status: 502, headers: baseHeaders(origin, { "Content-Type": "application/json" }) },
      );
    }

    console.log(`────────────────────────────────────────`);
    console.log(`${request.method} ${pathname} → ${res.status} (${Date.now() - start}ms)`);
    for (const line of log) console.log(line);

    if (request.method === "HEAD") {
      return new Response(null, { status: res.status, headers: res.headers });
    }
    return res;
  },
};

import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach, afterEach, vi } from "vitest";
import worker, { __resetInflightApod, normalizeApod } from "../src/index";

// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// In-memory stand-ins for globals the Worker reaches for. Node gives us
// Request/Response/fetch/URL natively; we only need to fake `caches.default`
// and route outbound `fetch` calls. The tests call the default export's
// fetch handler directly — no wrangler, no miniflare, no real network.
// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

interface CacheEntry {
  body: ArrayBuffer;
  headers: [string, string][];
}

function createCache() {
  const store = new Map<string, CacheEntry>();
  const cache = {
    async match(req: Request | string): Promise<Response | undefined> {
      const url = typeof req === "string" ? req : req.url;
      const entry = store.get(url);
      if (!entry) return undefined;
      return new Response(entry.body.slice(0), { headers: entry.headers });
    },
    async put(req: Request | string, res: Response): Promise<void> {
      const url = typeof req === "string" ? req : req.url;
      const body = await res.arrayBuffer();
      const headers: [string, string][] = [];
      res.headers.forEach((value, key) => headers.push([key, value]));
      store.set(url, { body, headers });
    },
    async delete(req: Request | string): Promise<boolean> {
      const url = typeof req === "string" ? req : req.url;
      return store.delete(url);
    },
    // helpers for assertions
    _keys: () => Array.from(store.keys()),
    _size: () => store.size,
  };
  return cache;
}

type CacheMock = ReturnType<typeof createCache>;

interface FetchCall {
  url: string;
  method: string;
  userAgent: string | null;
}

type RouteHandler = (req: Request) => Response | Promise<Response>;

function createFetchMock() {
  const routes: Array<{ match: (url: string) => boolean; handler: RouteHandler }> = [];
  const calls: FetchCall[] = [];

  const fn: typeof fetch = async (input, init) => {
    const req =
      input instanceof Request
        ? new Request(input, init)
        : new Request(typeof input === "string" ? input : String(input), init);
    calls.push({ url: req.url, method: req.method, userAgent: req.headers.get("User-Agent") });
    for (const route of routes) {
      if (route.match(req.url)) return route.handler(req);
    }
    throw new Error(`fetch mock: no route for ${req.url}`);
  };

  return Object.assign(fn, {
    calls,
    when(matcher: string | RegExp, handler: RouteHandler) {
      const match =
        typeof matcher === "string"
          ? (url: string) => url.includes(matcher)
          : (url: string) => matcher.test(url);
      routes.push({ match, handler });
    },
    urlsMatching(pattern: string | RegExp): string[] {
      return calls
        .map((c) => c.url)
        .filter((u) => (typeof pattern === "string" ? u.includes(pattern) : pattern.test(u)));
    },
  });
}

type FetchMock = ReturnType<typeof createFetchMock>;

// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Test harness state
// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

let cache: CacheMock;
let fetchMock: FetchMock;
let originalFetch: typeof fetch | undefined;
let originalCaches: typeof caches | undefined;

const DEV_ENV = { ENVIRONMENT: "development" };
const PROD_ENV = {};

// Pin "now" to a deterministic instant so todayET() always returns 2026-04-10.
// 16:00 UTC on 2026-04-10 is 12:00 ET — safely inside the same ET day.
const PINNED_NOW = new Date("2026-04-10T16:00:00Z");
const TODAY = "2026-04-10";
const YESTERDAY = "2026-04-09";

beforeEach(() => {
  vi.useFakeTimers();
  vi.setSystemTime(PINNED_NOW);

  cache = createCache();
  fetchMock = createFetchMock();

  originalFetch = globalThis.fetch;
  originalCaches = (globalThis as unknown as { caches?: typeof caches }).caches;

  (globalThis as unknown as { fetch: typeof fetch }).fetch = fetchMock;
  (globalThis as unknown as { caches: { default: CacheMock } }).caches = {
    default: cache,
  };

  __resetInflightApod();
});

afterEach(() => {
  vi.useRealTimers();
  if (originalFetch) {
    (globalThis as unknown as { fetch: typeof fetch }).fetch = originalFetch;
  }
  if (originalCaches) {
    (globalThis as unknown as { caches: typeof caches }).caches = originalCaches;
  } else {
    delete (globalThis as unknown as { caches?: unknown }).caches;
  }
});

// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Canned responses
// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

const ASSETS = "https://assets.science.nasa.gov";

function jsonResponse(body: unknown, status = 200): Response {
  return new Response(JSON.stringify(body), {
    status,
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
  });
}

function imageResponse(label: string, contentType = "image/jpeg"): Response {
  // Label the body so we can assert which mocked image was served.
  const bytes = new TextEncoder().encode(`IMAGE:${label}`);
  return new Response(bytes, {
    status: 200,
    headers: {
      "Content-Type": contentType,
      "Content-Length": String(bytes.byteLength),
    },
  });
}

/** apod-basic keys entries by YYMMDD. */
function yymmdd(date: string): string {
  return date.slice(2).replaceAll("-", "");
}

/** A raw apod-basic record the way science.nasa.gov sends it. */
function apodBasic(date: string, overrides: Record<string, unknown> = {}) {
  return {
    date,
    title: `Image for ${date}`,
    media_type: "image",
    explanation: `<strong>Explanation: </strong>Explanation for ${date}.`,
    copyright: `<a href="mailto:x">Photographer</a>`,
    hdurl: `${ASSETS}/dynamicimage/assets/science/cds/apod/apod/2026/april/${date}.jpg?w=4000&h=3000`,
    permalink: `https://science.nasa.gov/image-article/apod-${date}/`,
    basic_html: "",
    ...overrides,
  };
}

function notFound(): Response {
  return jsonResponse({ code: "apod_basic_not_found", message: "APOD not found.", data: { status: 404 } }, 404);
}

/** Route the apod-basic request for one date. */
function upstream(date: string, handler: RouteHandler): void {
  fetchMock.when(`/apod-basic/${yymmdd(date)}?`, handler);
}

function invoke(path: string, env: Record<string, string> = DEV_ENV): Promise<Response> {
  const req = new Request(`http://localhost:8787${path}`);
  // Silence the handler's per-request console noise during tests.
  const logSpy = vi.spyOn(console, "log").mockImplementation(() => {});
  return Promise.resolve(worker.fetch(req, env)).finally(() => logSpy.mockRestore());
}

// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Tests
// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

describe("?dev=video — video APOD with poster", () => {
  it("/info reports media_type=video and image_source=video_thumbnail", async () => {

    expect(body.title).toMatch(/video/i);

    // url is the video, hdurl is the poster we serve at /
    expect(body.url).toMatch(/^https:\/\/www\.youtube\.com\/embed\//);
    expect(body.hdurl).toMatch(/^https:\/\/assets\.science\.nasa\.gov\/content\/dam\/science\/cds\/apod\//);
  });

describe("?dev=nasa-error — upstream failure", () => {
  it("serves the stale cache entry when one is present", async () => {

    const staleBody = normalizeApod(apodBasic(TODAY, { title: "From Stale Cache" }), TODAY);
    await cache.put(
      new Request(staleUrl),

  it("trims whitespace and ignores empty entries in ?tools", () => {
    const url = new URL("https://api.nasapicture.com/?tools=palette,%20,grid,");
    const flags = parseDevFlags(url, { ENVIRONMENT: "development" });
    expect(flags.tools).toEqual(new Set(["palette", "grid"]));
  });

  it("treats ENVIRONMENT values other than 'development' as production", () => {
    const url = new URL("https://api.nasapicture.com/?dev=video");
    const flags = parseDevFlags(url, { ENVIRONMENT: "staging" });
    expect(flags.enabled).toBe(false);
    expect(flags.mode).toBeNull();
  });

  it("leaves mode and tools independent (both can coexist)", () => {
    const url = new URL("https://api.nasapicture.com/?dev=stale&tools=palette,grid");
    const flags = parseDevFlags(url, { ENVIRONMENT: "development" });
    expect(flags.mode).toBe("stale");
    expect(flags.tools).toEqual(new Set(["palette", "grid"]));
  });
});

// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// apodAssetPath
// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
describe("apodAssetPath", () => {
  const path = "science/cds/apod/apod/2026/october/AntiRainbow_Esposti_5120.jpg";

  it("extracts the asset path from a dynamicimage URL, ignoring the query", () => {
    expect(apodAssetPath(`${ASSETS}/dynamicimage/assets/${path}?w=5120&h=3840&fit=clip`)).toBe(path);
  });

  it("extracts the asset path from a content/dam URL (older entries)", () => {
    expect(apodAssetPath(`${ASSETS}/content/dam/${path}?w=3000`)).toBe(path);
  });

  it("keeps percent-encoded filenames verbatim", () => {
    const encoded = "science/cds/apod/apod/2026/october/Harvest%20Moon%20Rise.jpg";
    expect(apodAssetPath(`${ASSETS}/dynamicimage/assets/${encoded}`)).toBe(encoded);
  });

  it("rejects the NASA logo, the placeholder thumbnail, videos, other hosts, and junk", () => {
    expect(apodAssetPath("https://science.nasa.gov/wp-content/themes/nasa-child/assets/images/nasa-logo@2x.png")).toBeNull();
    expect(apodAssetPath(`${ASSETS}/dynamicimage/assets/science/astro/programs/cosmic-origins/images/misc/news-thumbnail.png?w=594`)).toBeNull();
    expect(apodAssetPath(`${ASSETS}/content/dam/science/cds/apod/apod/2026/october/CRS35-Holland30s1080p.mp4`)).toBeNull();
    expect(apodAssetPath(`http://assets.science.nasa.gov/content/dam/${path}`)).toBeNull();
    expect(apodAssetPath(`https://evil.example/content/dam/${path}`)).toBeNull();
    expect(apodAssetPath("")).toBeNull();
    expect(apodAssetPath("not a url")).toBeNull();
  });
});

// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// normalizeApod (real recorded apod-basic responses)
// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
describe("normalizeApod", () => {
  it("maps an image day to plain text and APOD asset URLs", () => {
    const apod = normalizeApod(image261020, "2026-10-20");
    const path = "science/cds/apod/apod/2026/october/AntiRainbow_Esposti_5120.jpg";

    expect(apod.date).toBe("2026-10-20");
    expect(apod.title).toBe("An Anticrepuscular Rainbow Fan");
    expect(apod.media_type).toBe("image");
    expect(apod.explanation).toMatch(/^This is an unusual rainbow\./);
    expect(apod.explanation).not.toMatch(/<|Explanation:/);
    expect(apod.copyright).toBe("Aurelia Degli Esposti");
    expect(apod.permalink).toBe("https://science.nasa.gov/image-article/apod-2026-october-20-an-anticrepuscular-rainbow-fan/");
    expect(apod.image).toEqual({
      sd: `${ASSETS}/dynamicimage/assets/${path}`,
      hd: `${ASSETS}/content/dam/${path}`,
      hdFallback: image261020.hdurl,
    });
  });

  it("keeps a YouTube day's poster as the image", () => {
    const apod = normalizeApod(youtube261018, "2026-10-18");
    expect(apod.media_type).toBe("video");
    expect(apod.image?.hd).toBe(`${ASSETS}/content/dam/science/cds/apod/apod/2026/october/SonifiedEagleNebulaPillars.jpg`);
    // Multi-line HTML credit flattens to one readable line.
    expect(apod.copyright).toBe(
      "Image Credit: NASA, ESA, & The Hubble Heritage Project (STScI/AURA); " +
      "Sonification: NASA, CXC, SAO, K. Arcand, M. Russo & A. Santaguida",
    );
  });

  it("keeps an MP4 day's poster as the image", () => {
    const apod = normalizeApod(mp4_261016, "2026-10-16");
    expect(apod.media_type).toBe("video");
    expect(apod.image?.hd).toMatch(/CRS35-Holland30s1080p\.jpg$/);
  });

  it("yields image: null for a video day with no poster (walkback, not an error)", () => {
    const apod = normalizeApod(videoNoPoster, "2026-10-16");
    expect(apod.media_type).toBe("video");
    expect(apod.image).toBeNull();
  });

  it("throws on an image day whose hdurl is not an APOD asset (the logo outage shape)", () => {
    expect(() => normalizeApod(logo, "2026-10-20")).toThrow(/no APOD image/);
  });

  it("throws when the record is for a different date", () => {
    expect(() => normalizeApod(image261020, "2026-10-19")).toThrow(/date mismatch/);
  });

  it("throws on schema failures", () => {
    expect(() => normalizeApod(notFound, "2026-12-31")).toThrow(/invalid record/);
    expect(() => normalizeApod({ ...image261020, title: " " }, "2026-10-20")).toThrow(/invalid record/);
    expect(() => normalizeApod({ ...image261020, media_type: "other" }, "2026-10-20")).toThrow(/invalid record/);
  });

  it("tolerates missing optional fields", () => {
    const apod = normalizeApod(
      { date: "2026-10-20", title: "T", media_type: "image", hdurl: image261020.hdurl },
      "2026-10-20",
    );
    expect(apod.explanation).toBe("");
    expect(apod.copyright).toBeNull();
    expect(apod.permalink).toBe("");
  });
});

// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// resolveApod
// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
describe("resolveApod", () => {
  const image = {
    sd: `${ASSETS}/dynamicimage/assets/science/cds/apod/apod/2026/april/test.jpg`,
    hd: `${ASSETS}/content/dam/science/cds/apod/apod/2026/april/test.jpg`,
    hdFallback: `${ASSETS}/dynamicimage/assets/science/cds/apod/apod/2026/april/test.jpg?w=4000`,
  };
  const base: Apod = {
    date: "2026-04-10",
    title: "Test Image",
    explanation: "...",
    copyright: null,
    media_type: "image",
    permalink: "https://science.nasa.gov/image-article/test/",
    image,
    video_url: null,
  };

  it("resolves an image APOD with source=image", () => {
    const r = resolveApod(base);
    expect(r).not.toBeNull();
    expect(r!.source).toBe("image");
    expect(r!.image).toBe(image);
  });

  it("resolves a video APOD with a poster as video_thumbnail", () => {
    const r = resolveApod({ ...base, media_type: "video", video_url: "https://www.youtube.com/embed/abc" });
    expect(r!.source).toBe("video_thumbnail");
    expect(r!.image).toBe(image);
  });

  it("returns null for a video APOD without a poster", () => {
    expect(resolveApod({ ...base, media_type: "video", image: null })).toBeNull();
  });
});

// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// devApodFixture
// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
describe("devApodFixture", () => {
  it("returns a video fixture with a poster on the APOD asset host for mode=video", () => {
    const f = devApodFixture("video", "2026-04-10");
    expect(f).not.toBeNull();
    expect(f!.date).toBe("2026-04-10");
    expect(f!.media_type).toBe("video");
    expect(f!.image).not.toBeNull();
    expect(apodAssetPath(f!.image!.hd)).not.toBeNull();
    expect(apodAssetPath(f!.image!.sd)).not.toBeNull();
    expect(f!.video_url).toMatch(/^https:\/\/www\.youtube\.com\/embed\//);
  });

  it("returns a video fixture without a poster for mode=video-no-thumb", () => {
    const f = devApodFixture("video-no-thumb", "2026-04-10");
    expect(f).not.toBeNull();
    expect(f!.media_type).toBe("video");
    expect(f!.image).toBeNull();
  });

  it("returns null for unknown modes (so the handler falls through)", () => {
    expect(devApodFixture("nasa-error", "2026-04-10")).toBeNull();
    expect(devApodFixture("palette", "2026-04-10")).toBeNull();
    expect(devApodFixture("", "2026-04-10")).toBeNull();
  });

  it("stamps the requested date onto the fixture", () => {
    expect(devApodFixture("video", "2020-01-01")!.date).toBe("2020-01-01");
  });

  it("produces fixtures that flow through resolveApod correctly", () => {
    const withPoster = devApodFixture("video", "2026-04-10")!;
    expect(resolveApod(withPoster)!.source).toBe("video_thumbnail");

    const noPoster = devApodFixture("video-no-thumb", "2026-04-10")!;
    expect(resolveApod(noPoster)).toBeNull();
  });
});
